2.translation: when the blind man came to him[1].
2.footnotes: [1] Abdullah ibn Um Maktūm, an early Muslim who was blind, came to the Prophet (ﷺ) seeking knowledge and guidance, while the Prophet (ﷺ) was in the middle of a discussion with some leading pagans of Makkah, calling them to Islam. The Prophet (ﷺ) frowned and turned his attention from him. So this Makkan surah was revealed.

3.translation: How would you know? Perhaps he might be purified[2],
3.footnotes: [2] Through the knowledge he learns from you.

4.translation: or he might take heed and benefit from the reminder?

5.footnotes: [3] Towards faith. Here it is referring to that influential pagan of the Quraysh whom the Prophet (ﷺ) had hoped to embrace Islam.

6.translation: you give him your full attention,

7.translation: although you are not to be blamed if he does not purify himself[4].
7.footnotes: [4] The Prophets are only responsible to convey the message, not for people’s guidance.

8.translation: But as for the one who came to you striving [for purification],

10.translation: you let yourself be distracted from him.

11.translation: No indeed; this is a reminder –

12.translation: so whoever wills may give heed to it –

17.translation: Woe to man; how ungrateful he is[5]!

18.translation: From what did He create him?

19.translation: He created him from a drop of semen and proportioned him[6],
19.footnotes: [6] His creation, provisions, life span, etc.

20.translation: then He made the way easy for him[7];
20.footnotes: [7] i.e., the way out of his mothers’ wombs (his birth), or the way to guidance.

21.translation: then He caused him to die and be buried;

22.translation: then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

23.translation: Yet he has not fulfilled what He commanded him.

24.translation: Let man consider the food he eats:

25.translation: How We pour down rainwater in torrents,

26.translation: and cause the soil to split open [for sprouts],

27.translation: and cause grains to grow in it,

28.translation: as well as grapes and fodder,

29.translation: and olive trees and date palms,

32.translation: as provision for you and your livestock.

33.translation: But when the Deafening Blast[8] comes,
33.footnotes: [8] The piercing Blast; the second Blast for resurrection.

34.translation: on that Day everyone will flee from his brother,

35.translation: and from his mother and father,

36.translation: and from his wife and children.

37.translation: On that day, everyone will have enough concern of his own[9].

38.translation: On that Day, some faces will be bright,

40.translation: while other faces will be dust-stained,

42.translation: Such are the disbelievers, the wicked.
